title: Crater Basin
concept: A contested crater basin sits inside a broad, traversable rim. Four ramps descend to the basin, and a lower outside circuit supports flanking.
difference: Unlike a random crater-shaped skirmish map, the ring route, basin approaches and mirrored economy are intentional parts of the layout.
routes: A continuous low outer circuit allows armies to rotate around the crater.
Four separated radial ramps connect the traversable rim to the central basin.
economy: Use the shared symmetric starting and expansion resources; preserve mirrored metal and geothermal spots on the ring and in contested basin approaches.
core_wishes: Registry and watermark assignment by the core integration owner.
